_comment: Lunar Trail balance overrides. Every key here is optional and mirrors a
field in src/sim/balance.h; anything absent keeps its shipped default.
This file is for TUNING EXPERIMENTS and for users who want a different
difficulty. The shipped game does not need it to exist.
Before changing anything here, read tools/balance_harness.cpp. Hand-tuning
the economy does not work: every value in balance.h was chosen from a
measurement made by that harness, not by reasoning. Change a number, re-run
the harness, and check the win-rate gradient still descends across the three
professions. A change that pushes all three tiers to a high win rate has
removed the difficulty rather than balanced it.

_examples._easier: Copy the block below over the matching top-level keys.

_noMining._note: Removes the requirement to mine, which removes the game's core tension. Do not ship this.
